fusions.name: Recited Verse
fusions.desc: Sends a stinger of sound that deals 7 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of the original damage. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds. Holds up to 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cascading Refrain
fusions.desc: A ringing verse deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Radiant Echo] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Well-Rehearsed
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 30% for 15 seconds. A chorus of stingers fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Choral Practice
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next strike has 15% more critical chance. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4. Once every 10 seconds.
